title: Advice on some simple game mechanics
author: Skumby73
selftext:
Heya peeps.  
  
So been have been working on a game called Nulltide. It's a Sci-Fi mobile game with Settlement Builder, Cloning (glorified trait-fishing machine), and rogue-like style expeditions with branching maps. At least, those are the 3 main systems. Players create and set some clones to jobs, others join the expedition squad (safety not guaranteed.)

Right now I've been working on desperately needed Juice and ended up deciding to overhaul some aspects of the settlement.

Originally, at least for testing and building systems, each building had its own asset on a settlement scene, that opened a screen with relevant info, upgrades, assigning workers etc. Then I had an idea so I made a simple scene where Farm/Well would become a sort of optimization mini-game. The optimization portion is simple, theres Food/Fiber/Herbs/Water in this scene. If water touches any of the other assets it boosts production. Thats it. Thats the small addition. I like this better than spreadsheet simulator.

 

https://preview.redd.it/5khopqvvef9h1.png?width=276&format=png&auto=webp&s=633c6fee61ef902c79f3d9315da10afeb186878a

  
The side bar pulls out to show pieces the player can use. Herbs/Fiber are 2x1s.

Im actually quite happy leaving it at that and not overcomplicating it because theres enough other features in this game.

But this got me thinking. How can I implement small fun mini-game kind of things to other parts of the settlement based around optimization?

For reference there are resource-tap buildings: Lumbermill, Quarry, Mines  
and Crafting buildings: Smelter, Forge, Workshop, Alchemist (to be renamed less fantasy-sounding).

So like I did here where I condensed the farm/well into 1 scene, I plan to condense the resource taps and crafting buildings to their 2 scenes.

https://preview.redd.it/5wpd3j76gf9h1.png?width=434&format=png&auto=webp&s=5cbca7e72f8d6e39d55048791549f510f2575a82

Ive come up with a simple worker assignment optimization for the resource taps as shown in the mock-up above. Each job likes a different clone stat and a productivity % would show under the job, which seemed fine enough, but I dont want to implement it cause I feel theres a more fun optimization mini-game I could cook up here.

I havent gotten to cooking up the crafting section's.

Any fun ideas for these 2 portions of the settlement system?
